title: The Room of Old Chapel Road
author: Kestrel Ravensworth
blurb: Edmund Thornbury, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
